senses.gloss: pr. n. pl. pr. n. pl. Meron, in Galilee, south of Giscala.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sheviit 9:2:10">Y. Shebi. IX, 38ᵈ</cite> bot.

<cite ref="Tosefta Demai 4:13">Tosef. Dem. IV, 13</cite> <he>מי׳</he> ed. Zuck. (Var. <cite ref="M01296"><he>מירוק</he></cite>). Tanḥ. ed. Bub., P’kudé 7 <he>בקעה שעל פני מ׳ וכ׳</he> the valley in front of M., his native town; <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 52:3">Ex. R. s. 52</cite> <he>בקעה אחת שעל פגי מרון</he> some ed. (corr. acc.).
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 8:1:1">Cant. R. to VIII, 1</cite> <he>מי׳</he>; <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 5:14">Ex. R. s. 5</cite>, beg. <he>בית מר׳</he> (not <he>מד׳</he>).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 4:5:11">Y. Taan. IV, 68ᵈ</cite> (in a fragmentary passage) <he>מי׳ קרתה</he> Meron (in connection with Jojarib) designates the place (of the family).
